propositions: _paged_search loops unbounded when a DC server ignores startAt and repeats the same page, with no offset-stall guard to detect non-advancement and terminate loudly
A server returning the same non-empty page at every offset causes _paged_search to exhaust only when the harness cap is hit (26 calls observed), not by the pager's own logic
get_parent_map wraps _paged_search in a broad except Exception handler that converts any stall error into a silent empty map {} degradation, neutralizing the transport-level signal

Three fetcher.fetch_snapshot enrichment handlers (parent, comment, issuelink) fail-open on ANY exception without naming BackendPaginationStallError, so transport-boundary stalls are swallowed and snapshots are written degraded
The fix must raise BackendPaginationStallError in core (not adapter-local) so that fetcher.py can name and re-raise it past all four fail-open sites without layering inversion
